lessons: The ticket never requires deleting tickets/<stem>/ticket.md after a commit failure. Steps 4-5 only say: write the file, commit it, and on failure write the decision-<id> record and resolve the message. Do not invent a cleanup step that needs a FileSystem delete method.

If you think a leftover file matters: the message resolves as `decision` and is never re-authored, and AuthorGate already refuses a stem whose dir exists. A stray draft file is harmless, so do not add any seams.py change. That file stays outside the fence.
Before declaring premise_failed, quote the exact ticket sentence that forces the out-of-fence change. If no such sentence exists, the gap is self-imposed. Implement within the fence instead.

Spend the budget on the real work: specs/author.md (lint_spec-clean, blocks request/files/open_tickets/retry_findings), chupa/author.py, the triage.py wiring, git.ls_files, and the eval-harness spec_major==1 change. Then run all three Verification commands.
